162.csv::46.source_text:
あの、お願いがあります！
居住区から出て資源の採取にゆきたいのですが
通り道にグリフィンの錬魔が居座ってしまったのです
162.csv::46.translated_text: Pardon me, I have a request! I would depart the residential district to gather resources, yet a Griffin alchemist has made its lair upon the path.
162.csv::46.speaker: Eunike

162.csv::47.source_text:
あの場所を避けて向かうのも難しく――
お願いです、地上の方
あの改造魔獣を撃退してください
162.csv::47.translated_text:
Reaching here whilst avoiding that place is also difficult...
I beg of you, you of the surface
Pray, drive back that remodeled magickal construct
162.csv::47.speaker: Eunike

162.csv::48.source_text:
あの場所を避けて資源の採取にも向かえず――
お願いです、地上の方
あの改造魔獣を撃退してください
162.csv::48.translated_text:
We avoid that place and cannot even gather resources—
I beg of you, you of the surface,
repel that altered magickal construct.
162.csv::48.speaker: Eunike

162.csv::49.source_text:
ああ、ああ！
本当に助かりました
何とお礼を言えばいいか――
162.csv::49.translated_text:
Ah, ah!
You have truly saved me.
How ever shall I thank you—
162.csv::49.speaker: Eunike

162.csv::50.source_text:
貴方へのお礼は後ほど
納めさせていただきますね
162.csv::50.translated_text: I shall render you my thanks anon.
162.csv::50.speaker: Eunike
